summary: New Fortress Energy filed an 8-K disclosing consummation, on September 11, 2026, of a comprehensive restructuring of its principal funded debt under two UK Part 26A restructuring plans, sanctioned June 18, 2026 and recognized under chapter 15 on June 29, 2026. The company separated into BrazilCo and CoreCo, terminated the 6.500% Senior Notes due 2026 and released related liens, per the March 17, 2026 RSA. No price, premium, or fee was stated. Watch execution and any residual claims or terminations.
